svg.title: The washer method: the region between y = √x and y = 1 revolved about the x-axis
svg.desc: Left: the region between y = √x (on top) and the line y = 1 (below), from x = 1 to x = 4, shaded, with one thin vertical rectangle from the line up to the curve. Arrows from the x-axis show the outer radius R up to the curve and the inner radius r up to the line. Right: the solid made by revolving the region about the x-axis, a flared horn with a round hole of radius 1 along the axis. The rectangle sweeps out a washer, highlighted in blue, with outer radius R = √x and inner radius r = 1, both measured from the x-axis. Each washer has volume π(R² − r²)Δx, so V = the integral from 1 to 4 of π[(√x)² − 1²] dx = 9π/2.
svg.text: Both radii start at the axis:
V = ∫ from 1 to 4 of π[(√x)2 − 12] dx
